core_obligations: Reduce the list: two of the conditions are equivalent by the unramified characterization, so in every case the morphism is DM (proof lines 8550-8554)
Present the morphism: choose a smooth surjective morphism onto the target and a surjective etale morphism from an algebraic space onto the fibre product of the source with it (proof lines 8555-8559)

Scheme-free step: it remains to see that the presenting morphism is etale exactly when it is unramified, flat and locally of finite presentation, which is the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces together with the trivial implications from etaleness (proof lines 8560-8566)
proof_roadmap: 由 unramified 的刻画得 (2)⟺(3)，于是每种情形 f 都是 DM。
由 DM 取 V → Y 满光滑与 U → X ×_Y V 满 étale。
只需证 U → V étale ⟺ 局部有限表现 + 平坦 + unramified（代数空间层面的对应定理 + étale 的平凡蕴含）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes etaleness of a morphism of algebraic stacks through an etale presentation over a smooth cover of the base (author lemma at source lines 8538-8548, label lemma-characterize-etale). The proof (source lines 8550-8567) uses the unramified characterization for one equivalence, produces the etale presentation from the DM characterization and reduces to the corresponding statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 8550-8566). The construction of the presentation and the reduction are the substance. H3.
